# Branch library opening hours — 2026-10-09

**Participants:** Moira Easterbrook (Branch Manager), Teo Lindahl (Librarian)

Moira: "We open at eight on Tuesdays and Thursdays so the commuter crowd can return books on the way in."

Teo: "And we close an hour earlier those days to keep the staffing flat."

payload.rationale: I covered the winter tool-library narrative and its position because both connect operating-hours changes with staffing allocation, while noting its seasonal, low-attendance context differs from this branch’s commuter-driven opening and flat-staffing tradeoff. I also included the ferry schedule narrative and position as a nearby schedule-adjustment thread that distinguishes changes by demand, though its ridership and weekday/weekend context is not the same. The map’s only named thematic area was GreenhouseMonitoring, and the remaining markdown and sensor threads do not plausibly overlap; Moira and Teo are not in the people roster, and the surfaced Xena actor entry adds no relevant context.
